narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Zero leaves things as they are, so twenty five times zero is twenty five.
<bookmark mark='plates'/>Twenty five times zero means zero groups of twenty five. There is nothing to count.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Adding zero changes nothing, but multiplying by zero gives zero.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Without zero and the negative numbers, some take away sums would have no answer.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Find nine plus zero, nine times zero, nine take away nine, and two take away six.
